PLAN "Cycle-Phased 12-Week Strength Programme"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public

GOALS

  PHASE "Follicular Power Block" (4 weeks):

      DAY Monday training 50m "Lower Body Strength — Follicular":
        warmup:
          walking 5m
        main straight_sets:
          goblet_squat 2x10 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          romanian_deadlift 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          leg_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          calf_raise 3x15 rpe 5 rest 45 seconds
        cooldown:
          hip_flexor_stretch 2m
          quad_stretch 2m
          hamstring_stretch 2m

      DAY Wednesday training 50m "Upper Body Strength — Follicular":
        warmup:
          rowing 5m
        main straight_sets:

          bent_over_row 3x8 rpe 6 rest 90 seconds

          lat_pulldown 3x10 rpe 6 rest 75 seconds
          lateral_raise 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          tricep_pushdown 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
          bicep_curl 3x12 rpe 5 rest 60 seconds
